pairs.wyg: 夫宅者乃是隂陽之樞紐人倫之軌模
pairs.hfl: 夫宅者乃是陰陽之樞紐人倫之軌模
pairs.observation: 隂/陰 differs in this opening. Kept literally, no blanket character conversion.

pairs.wyg: 非夫博物明賢而能悟斯道也
pairs.hfl: 非夫博物明賢無能悟斯道也
pairs.observation: 而/無 changes the recorded wording. Without matching facsimile pages, do not declare which is an OCR error or repair either text.
藥/樂 differs in the recorded transcription. Requires image checking before editorial correction.

scope: Three selected comparisons in volume 1, not a full-book collation or assessment of feng shui effects. These transcriptions are supplemental research evidence and are not introduced as user-facing room rules.
